buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Supply and installation of Hazard Advisory Markers for U/G mines and surface at different colli eries of Mugma Area. 1. Hazard Advisory Markers shall be installed at various locations within the mines under Mugma Area, Eas tern Coalfields Limited, as specified by us to the successful bidder after award of the contract. 2. The bidder may, at his own responsibility and cost, visit and inspect the site(s) where the Hazard Adviso ry Markers are proposed to be installed before submission of the bid. The design, content, and lettering of the Hazard Advisory Markers, in any language(s) as required, shall be provided by us to the successful bid der after award of the contract. During such a visit, the bidder may assess the proposed installation locations, prevailing mine and ground conditions, required ground clearance, suitability of the back frame and stand design, and any other inform ation considered necessary by the bidder for successful execution of the work. The bidder shall be deemed to have fully acquainted himself with all relevant site conditions, and no claim arising out of ignorance or lack of knowledge of such conditions shall be entertained. The site visit is optio nal.

3. The contractor shall arrange all necessary accessories, tools, equipment, and machinery, as required ba sed on the actual site conditions, and shall complete the installation within the stipulated time and in accor dance with the terms and conditions of the NIT. 4. The base material of the Hazard Advisory Markers/Boards shall not contain aluminium or magnesium. Bi dders must submit test certificate from Govt./accredited laboratory along with their bid. 5. The bidder must submit a tender-specific Authorization Certificate and Compliance Certificate, duly sign ed by the manufacturer of the acrylic reflective sheeting. The certificates shall unequivocally confirm that t he offered product strictly and fully complies with all technical specifications stipulated in the NIT, without any deviation whatsoever. 6. The bidder must submit Job Completion Certificate(s) along with satisfactory Performance Certificate(s) f or Hazard Advisory Markers, issued by an underground coal mine, confirming satisfactory performance aft er completion of the stipulated guarantee/warranty period. . 4. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of EASTERN COALFIELDS LIMITED AREA VIII payable at DHANBAD . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.
